martial_training_run_sequence_help: Use normal and special, separated by an English comma.
normal_enable_help: Search and challenge normal-ticket bosses in the configured sequence.
normal_limit_help: Counts only after the search button enters the locked state; an existing boss is not counted again.
special_enable_help: Search and challenge special-ticket bosses in the configured sequence.
special_limit_help: Counts only after the search button enters the locked state; an existing boss is not counted again.
